description: Integer div and mod with TLA+ floor division instead of Java truncation
and, or, implies strict in undefined instead of USE's Kleene tables
forAll counting an undefined body as true instead of false
select keeping elements whose body is undefined
includes/excludes on an undefined collection undefined instead of false
oclIsKindOf of an undefined value false instead of true (OclVoid conforms to every type)
including/excluding strict in the element (the first translator bug found)
Set->collect yielding a set instead of a bag
navigation from an undefined object to a many-end yielding the empty set instead of undefined
= strict in undefined instead of undefined = undefined being true
if with an undefined condition taking the else branch instead of being undefined
